$comment: Shared recitation-match rules (contracts RECITATION_MATCH). Generated by services/api/scripts/build-recitation-fixtures.ts.
normalize: Remove U+0610–U+061A, U+064B–U+065F, U+0670, U+06D6–U+06ED, U+08D3–U+08FF (tashkeel, Quranic marks, small letters).
Eastern digits ٠–٩ → 0–9; أ إ آ ٱ ٲ ٳ → ا; ة → ه; ى → ي; ؤ → و; ئ → ي; drop tatweel ـ; lower-case; collapse whitespace.
words: Split on whitespace; drop tokens made only of U+06D6–U+06ED, U+06DD, U+06DE, ٠–٩, U+FD3E, U+FD3F, 0–9 (ayah-end and pause marks). A word index counts the rest.
wordKey: Replace U+0670 (dagger alef) with ا, normalise, keep only U+0621–U+064A.
same: Keys equal, or both at least 4 letters and Levenshtein distance ≤ 1.
opening: Before aligning, drop from the start of what is heard the isti'adha (أعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم) and then the Basmala (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم) unless the passage itself begins with the Basmala (checked with `same`: the mushaf writes الرحمن with a dagger alef); heard words compare by exact key. A partial phrase at the end of what is heard is 'open' (live following waits) and is not dropped. Dropped words are neither heard nor extra (`openingWords`).
align: Word-level Levenshtein (substitution cost 0 when same, else 1; deletion = expected word not heard; insertion = extra heard word). Backtrace from the end: same and diagonal equal → ok; else up (+1) → skipped; else diagonal (+1) → warn; else left (extra heard word).

scores.extraRatio: heard words (after the opening) paired with no expected word (not ok/warn) ÷ heard words; 0 when nothing heard
scores.segments: A heard entry with several words is split; its span is shared equally between them.

verdict: no heard words (after the opening) → reject unclear
coverage ≥ 0.75 and speech ≥ 0.4 and extraRatio ≤ 0.5 → approve
words_map: Each ok/warn expected word → {ayah, index, startMs, endMs} of the heard word it aligned to, in order. Rounded to 4 decimals: coverage, extraRatio, speech.
